Method of Attack: Custom HTTP proxy and backdoor tool creating an HTTP service monitoring incoming requests for specific URL patterns to hide commands
IIS backdoor monitoring incoming HTTP requests for a specific Cookie field carrying commands for execution on the host
Attack Vector: Installation of web shells after exploiting vulnerabilities in internet-facing servers
Use of web shells such as reGeorg, China Chopper, and AspxSpy for initial compromise
Indicators of Compromise: Embedded DLL file named wmipd.dll variant of OwlProxy
Specific URL patterns and Cookie fields in HTTP requests used to carry commands
